I couldn’t find an exact product/brand page for **“Wiggle & Snug”**, but if you mean the **Beezpro “Snug Fit Padded underwear Single Piece Trial Pack”**, it **appears to still be listed for purchase**: the page shows the product at **Rs. 255.00**, size options, and an **“Add to cart”** button. There is also “Sale Sold out” text on the page, so I’d treat the checkout/cart as the final confirmation of stock. ([beezpro.in](https://beezpro.in/products/padded-underwear-single-piece-trial-mixed-colors-only-copy))

A couple of notes: it’s described as a **sample/trial piece**, **non-returnable and non-exchangeable**, and intended for testing the fit before buying more. ([beezpro.in](https://beezpro.in/products/padded-underwear-single-piece-trial-mixed-colors-only-copy))

If you’re ordering from the **United States**, Beezpro’s shipping policy only mentions shipping **across India**, so you may need to contact them to confirm whether they’ll ship internationally. Their contact page lists **wesupport@beezpro.in** and WhatsApp **9025509291**. ([beezpro.in](https://beezpro.in/policies/shipping-policy)) ([beezpro.in](https://beezpro.in/pages/contact))
